status.desc: Statuses: auto view, emoji, reply, forward
status.usage:
*Statuses*
› Auto view: *{0}*
› Emoji: *{1}*
› Reply: *{2}*
› Sent to: *{3}*

*Examples:*
› status on — view and receive every status
› status off
› status no-dl — view only, without receiving them
› status hide-view — view without the "seen" receipt
› status &delay — wait a little before viewing
› status only-view 2250700000000,2250700000001
› status except-view 2250700000000
› status emoji 🔥,❤️ · status emoji off
› status msg Nice status! · status msg off
› status forward 2250700000000 · status forward me

_Options combine: status no-dl &delay_

delete.example:
> *Usage Examples:*
- delete g - Send deleted msgs in same chat
- delete p - Send deleted msgs to your chat
- delete g pm - Same chat, PMs only
- delete g gm - Same chat, groups only
- delete p no-gm - To you, exclude groups
- delete p no-pm - To you, exclude PMs
- delete 2250700000000 - Send to this number
- delete off - Disable

*Scopes:* pm, gm, no-pm, no-gm
delete.dest_sudo: _Deleted messages will be sent to your chat._
delete.dest_chat: _Deleted messages will be sent to the chat itself._

antivv.desc: Auto view-once: forwards every view-once you receive where you want
antivv.example:
> *Usage Examples:*
- antivv p - Send every view-once to your chat
- antivv g - Send it in the same chat
- antivv p pm - PMs only
- antivv p gm - Groups only
- antivv p no-gm / antivv p no-pm
- antivv 2250700000000 - Send to this number
- antivv off - Disable

*Scopes:* pm, gm, no-pm, no-gm
antivv.dest_sudo: _View-once messages will be sent to your chat._
antivv.dest_chat: _View-once messages will be sent to the chat itself._
